Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions, and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two distinct OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid obtained from an aliphatic diisocyanate.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating, as measured, is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating, characterized as root mean square roughness, is greater than 200 nm.
